description:
Takahara Hairi never expected summer to feel like a dream. Sent to Torishirojima Island to sort through his late grandmother’s belongings, he’s met with endless sea, quiet nostalgia, and mysterious girls, each chasing something just out of reach. As he settles into island life, lost memories begin to surface and he finds what he never knew he’d lost.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

node.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Shiroha is the main heroine of Summer Pockets. She is a calm and shy girl who doesn’t have any friends. While she is anxious around strangers, she is also well-composed. Other than her blood-related grandfather, she has nobody who can even be called a friend. She was a loner for a bit too long, so she’s somewhat socially awkward. She frequently gazes over the sea on the isolated island.

Kamome is a mysterious girl who is seen from time to time on the island, and is always dragging  a big suitcase along with her. She uses the suitcase in many clever ways and when it gets annoying, she just rides on top of it. It seems that, like Hairi, she came to the island for just this summer. She has a bad habit of meddling with things out of pure curiosity and getting herself in danger, so it's sort of hard to leave her on her own. It looks like she came to the island to search for something. In her hands is an old map… "This is a treasure map!"

Ao is a girl who doesn't care about genders and talks to everyone like they're her friend, and has a tendency to purposefully ignore everything love-related. Ao acts like one of the core members of a local boy-scouts-like group; promptly taking command of any situation. She may not seem like it, but she is a covert pervert. Ao frequently mishears words and misinterprets them in a erotic way, only to become bashful herself. She works part-time at the island's candy shop, and the local kids call her "Sensei''. If she has the time, she can sleep anywhere.

Tsumugi is a calm and honest half-German girl who decided to use this summer vacation to, "look for things she wants to do". Her personal philosophy is, "Classic books and rules were polished over time to be as rational as possible". Because of that, she even follows rules that clearly don't fit modern society. She is a bit lenient though, and doesn't try to force others to follow those rules. For someone who always talks about rules and logic, whenever she loses a debate, she moans with a mortifying "Mugyu~". Even though she is a calm and collected girl and it feels like she can do anything, sometimes she just blankly stares somewhere or starts talking in monotone. And then there are times when her clothes are frayed like she just rampaged through the mountains. She unexpectedly has a lot of weak points.

Umi is the second cousin of Hairi Takahara who has lived her whole life in the city, but she always admired life in the countryside and it’s the reason why she has come to Torishirojima for the summer. During the summer, she often cooks for Hairi. Her specialty is fried rice; she's extremely passionate about fried rice.

~!She is the daughter of Hairi and Shiroha in the future.!~

Hairi is a young man who is not a native to Torishirojima, as he grew up in a more urban area. He used to be a dedicated swimmer at his high school in the city, but after a certain incident he is now afraid of going into the water. Due to said incident, he uses the recent death of his grandmother as an excuse to come to the island for the summer to take care of her estate sale.

Shizuku is the student council president at the heroines' school on the mainland. During summer vacation, she travels to the island to meet with Tsumugi. She has an extraordinary love and respect for breasts. It's not that she's interested in women; she just has a pure admiration for breasts.

Shiki is a travel-loving girl who has come to Torishirojima. She collects tall tales about oni around Japan and has come to visit the island to hear more about the legends of the oni that remain on the island. Although she says it’s her first time on the island, she also appears in places that islanders don’t know about. She’s got great survival skills, especially regarding finding food to eat… or that’s supposed to be the case. She’s often found collapsed on the side of the road, pleading for food.

Nomiki is a girl who lives on the island who is a member of the Torishirojima Public Order Executives, protecting the island's morals daily. She's also in charge of radio broadcasts across the island, and will keep lookout for troublemakers from atop the radio tower. She carries her own customized water gun called the "Hydro Gladiator Kai" in order to mercilessly punish evildoers.

Ryouichi is a local on Torishirojima. He can often be seen running around shirtless in the name of freedom. This often causes a conflict with Nomiki, as she considers it indecent. He can often be seen hanging out in his and Tenzen’s secret base.

Tenzen is a local on Torishirojima. On the outside, he looks very serious and cool. However, he has dedicated too much of his time to table tennis, so his speech and manners are often very unusual. He brought a ping pong table to his and Ryouichi's secret base and trains rigorously every day.
Ao's twin sister, who she is very protective of.
